benchmark.definition: equal-weight daily-rebalanced mean of the cached universe's pct_chg close-to-close returns over the same window; stale observations are excluded from that session

benchmark_definition: equal-weight daily-rebalanced mean of the cached universe's pct_chg close-to-close returns over the same window; stale observations are excluded from that session
disclaimer: paper tracking only; style-tilt demo, not validated alpha
return_basis: pct_chg/100 (Baostock ex-rights preclose); raw close is used only for volume x price cost conversion and the stale liquidation reference
stale_policy: a session is stale when pct_chg or volume is missing/zero; hold at the last valid close (return 0, flagged stale); when the price returns the resume-day pct_chg carries the gap return; after max_stale_sessions consecutive stale sessions, liquidate at the last valid close with no extra trade cost (no tradable price exists) and hold the proceeds as cash
tradable_gate: execution buys require close > 0, finite pct_chg, volume > 0 (R9 tradable_mask) and pct_chg <= 9.8% (R19a limit-up approximation); blocked weight stays in cash with a warning
